message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && grep -rn "BLOSC_DOSHUFFLE\|BLOSC_DOBITSHUFFLE\|BLOSC_DODELTA\|BLOSC_MEMCPYED\|BLOSC_DOSHUFFLE\b" blosc/blosc2.h | head

message.content:
So `BLOSC2_MAX_FILTERS = 6` and `BLOSC2_VERSION_FORMAT_ALPHA = 3`. When the header version is 3 (alpha), `max_filters = 5`, so `context->filters[5]` and `context->filters_meta[5]` are left uninitialized.

Then in `blosc_d`, `last_filter(filters, 'd')` iterates over all 6 entries (indices 5 down to 0), reading `filters[5]` which is uninitialized. This is the use-of-uninitialized-value.

Let me check the header flags. The extended header is used when both `BLOSC_DOSHUFFLE` and `BLOSC_DOBITSHUFFLE` are set. Let me check the flag values.
